name: dsh-sample
description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness plugin, written to be read: two tools, one optional HTTP route, one config schema, and the bundle patch that mounts it.

comments.dependencies: None, deliberately. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` are imported at runtime and resolved from the HOST's node_modules — they are the harness this plugin is mounted into, not libraries it may pin a version of. The project root lists them so a fresh checkout has them; see its package.json.
comments.file-dep: The project root depends on this directory with a `file:` spec rather than copying it, so `cordis.patch.yml` can name the PACKAGE (`dsh-sample`) instead of a relative path and Node resolution finds the code from wherever a profile lives. Note that pnpm — which `dsh plugin add` forwards to — cannot resolve a file: spec whose absolute path contains a space; use npm at the project root if your checkout is under such a path.
